rows.name: Did you foresee this, Alviss?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No need to be angry.[XENO:n ]
I only wanted to analyse the boy.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Which was the point, no?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]I did not interfere with your ministerial affairs.[XENO:n ]
In fact, you should be thanking me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT15 ][XENO:del del=this ]
I wonder if he feels the same.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]We have all the information we need.[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You see...nothing can befall him[XENO:n ]
before he sees his dream fulfilled.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
